verdict.rationale: The documented `dev` CLI command runs a server on your machine that executes Trigger.dev tasks. Independent users praise Dev mode and say local testing is easy with no complex configuration. Separate environments and preview branches can be targeted, and the platform can be self-hosted with `docker compose up`. Missing for 10: documented CI testing workflow (the GitHub Action evidence covers deployment, not test runs), and test utilities or mocking for running tasks in automated tests.
